description: Flag one block of a renderable artifact and optionally comment on it - the block-level equivalent of comment/approve. First read the artifact with get_artifact to get each block's `anchor` and `text`, then call this once per block. Address a block by `anchor` (preferred) or by `quoted_text` (a verbatim snippet; the server resolves it). `status` is exactly one of: needs_review = look at this again (also auto-set when a flagged block changes on re-publish); needs_work = changes required; done = the needed action is complete; approved = signed off; reject_remove = this block should be removed. A comment is allowed only once a status is set. Set status empty to clear a flag. If a block was REWRITTEN since it was flagged (get_artifact shows it with `rewritten: true` and no live anchor), address its thread by `annotation_id` instead of an anchor - that is the only way to close or reply to it. Only works when the collection has requested review.

annotationId.description:
annotation_id addresses an existing thread by id instead - the ONLY way to
 reach one whose block was rewritten (from get_artifact's block.annotation_id).

collectionId.description: the collection you are reviewing (access + opt-in)

comment.description: optional; allowed only when a status is set

quotedText.description: ... or by quoting the block's text (server resolves)

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

status.description:
status is one of needs_review, needs_work, done, approved, reject_remove.
 Empty clears the flag.

name: review_block
title: Review one block
